text: Computer vision is a field of artificial intelligence that enables computers to see and understand the world through images and videos. Instead of just taking pictures, computers use complex algorithms to perform image recognition, identifying what is in a photo, such as a cat, a tree, or a person. One of its main tasks is object detection, where the system not only recognizes an object but also finds its exact location in the image. This technology has many practical applications, from scanning barcodes to analyzing medical scans. Perhaps most impressively, computer vision is essential for self-driving cars, helping them detect pedestrians, road signs, and other vehicles to navigate safely without a human driver.
